name: skill-standards
description: Standards for authoring and reviewing discoverable, portable, safe agent skills.

interface.shortDescription: Author and review agent skills to a verifiable bar
interface.longDescription: Hold agent skills to a checkable standard: discoverable descriptions, lean bodies with progressive disclosure, honest references, and safety review for skills loaded into untrusted repositories.
defaultPrompt: Review this skill against the skill-standards checklist and report problems.
